measurements.title: Goldring 2100 — Micro Seiki DQX-500 — 1 kHz Reference Check
measurements.summary: The Micro Seiki DQX-500 / Goldring 2100 capture measured 33.36 RPM (+0.09%) with 0.032% DIN-shaped wow and flutter RMS. Average separation was 21.8 dB at 1 kHz and channel balance was +0.32 dB. Harmonic levels were steady during the recording, with THD of 1.37% left and 1.97% right.
